dinolevel.title: Higher dino levels
dinolevel.subtitle: How to push a tamed creature's level higher — written down from the owner's own testing
dinolevel.what.title: What this does
dinolevel.what.1: A creature you have already tamed can be freed and tamed a second time. Each pass lands at a higher tame level than the one before, so the same creature ends up further above where it started without being bred.
dinolevel.what.2: This is a game mechanic, not a tool in Razor Reaper — there is nothing here to click. It is written down from the owner's own testing and worked at the time it was written. There is no video for it yet.
dinolevel.steps.title: Step by step
dinolevel.step.1.head: Unclaim the tamed dino
dinolevel.step.1.detail: It has to be unclaimed before anything else works.
dinolevel.step.2.head: Catch it with a Noglin
dinolevel.step.2.detail: Take the creature over so the Noglin is holding it.
dinolevel.step.3.head: Upload the Noglin at a transmitter
dinolevel.step.3.detail: Put the Noglin itself into the upload, not the creature.
dinolevel.step.4.head: Leave render distance
dinolevel.step.4.detail: Move far enough away that the area unloads for you.
dinolevel.step.5.head: Wait until the Noglin is gone from render
dinolevel.step.5.detail: Give it time — this is the part that is easy to cut short.
dinolevel.step.6.head: Come back
dinolevel.step.6.detail: The creature should be standing there free again.
dinolevel.step.7.head: Tame it again
dinolevel.step.7.detail: A normal tame, on the creature you just freed.
dinolevel.step.8.head: Repeat
dinolevel.step.8.detail: Every round starts from a higher tame level than the last.
dinolevel.requirements.title: Requirements
dinolevel.requirement.1: A Noglin — a high level one is likely to be needed.
dinolevel.requirement.2: A transmitter to upload the Noglin at.
dinolevel.requirement.3: The dino unclaimed before you start.
dinolevel.tips.title: Tips & caveats
dinolevel.tip.1: Leave render properly — half out is not out, and the step will not fire.
dinolevel.tip.2: Keep the Noglin safe; you need it again for the next round.
dinolevel.tip.3: Results can differ by server settings, so treat the levels you get as your server's, not a fixed number.

building.fence.title: Fence Pillars
building.fence.sub: Cheap to push, easy to destroy — pick your spots wisely.
building.fence.copy1: Perfect for push. Build wherever — they're easy to destroy, so use Tek Crop Plots when you need them to survive.
building.fence.copy2: Great for soaking with an FFA Teleporter or pushing with turrets. For turret caps, use Tek Fence Pillars.
building.fence.warning: Method 2 can count as a floating structure — use carefully.
building.floating.title: Floating Structures
building.floating.copy: Adding turrets to a floating hatchframe can flip it into illegal floating — see below.
building.illegal.title: Illegal Floating Methods
building.illegal.sub: Pillar + fish net, hatchframe + trapdoor, kav/S+ fridge snaps.
building.illegal.callout: Server rules vary. These methods abuse snap-points and may be wiped by admins. Reference only.
